surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `id` to register the trigger in the store of the preview card, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the trigger, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

returnTypeDifferences.reason: `PreviewCard.Handle` is the class `PreviewCardHandle`. The declaration of the function names the class, and Base UI documents the same class by its name in the namespace.
